# uiui

> uiui (YOO-ee-YOO-ee) is a dense console design system in one CSS file, inspired by the Unifi console: app shell, filter sidebar, detail drawer, data tables, port grids, charts, light and dark. Plain HTML, no build, made for agents to copy from.

uiui is pronounced YOO-ee-YOO-ee. Source: https://github.com/statico/uiui (MIT).

## Docs

- [Agent guide](/skill.md): widget list, page recipes, composition rules. Read this first.
- [Style guide as markdown](/index.md): the whole site in one markdown page.
- [Style guide](/): every widget with copyable HTML, light and dark.
- [The stylesheet](/src/uiui.css): the entire library, one file.
